## About
R&D Auto Electric is a mechanical and electrical repair shop in Richmond that moved here from Oakland. Electrical failures, electrical diagnostics and auto computer problems are our specialty, and we also take care of preventive maintenance and minor and major repairs on cars, trucks, vans and commercial vehicles.
Today's vehicles run on computers and electronic modules, so finding the problem takes the right knowledge and the right diagnostic equipment. We use quality aftermarket parts and, when it makes sense and they're available, OEM parts, because cheap parts tend to fail fast and cost you more down the road.
Customers mention Rene and Douglas by name and say they keep bringing the whole family's cars back. We're rated 4.9 from 38 Google reviews.

## Services
- Auto electrical and computer diagnostics: Electrical failures, electrical diagnostics and auto computer related problems, handled with up-to-date diagnostic equipment.
- Diesel engines: Experience with diesel engines from Mercedes-Benz, Isuzu, Ford Truck, Dodge Ram, Cummins and more.
- Diesel fuel in engine coolant: We can track down problems like diesel fuel in your engine coolant and cracks in the heads at the injector sleeves.
- General maintenance, oil and filter: Routine maintenance to keep your vehicle running properly.
- Engine work and transmission servicing: Engine work, run-ability issues and transmission servicing for gas and diesel cars and trucks.
- Brakes and hydraulics: Brake and hydraulic work for cars and trucks.
- A/C service: Air conditioning service for your vehicle.
- Emission systems: Diagnosis and repair of emission systems.

## FAQ
Q: What kinds of vehicles do you work on?
A: American, European and Asian vehicles with gasoline or diesel engines, including passenger vehicles, vans and commercial vehicles.

Q: Are you open on Saturdays?
A: Usually, yes. Some Saturdays the shop may be closed because of advanced schooling, so it's a good idea to call ahead.
